title: Ultrasonic Surface Modification of WC-Co-Cr Thermal Spray Coatings: Microstructure, Mechanical Properties and Performance
authors: Lyaila Bayatanova, Нуртолеу Магазов, Bauyrzhan Rakhadilov, Arystanbek Kussainov, M.K. Kaliaskarova, Dauir Kakimzhanov
abstract: Thermal-sprayed WC–Co–Cr coatings are widely used to improve the wear and corrosion resistance of steel components operating under severe service conditions. This study investigates WC–Co–Cr coatings deposited by detonation spraying (DS), high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF), and atmospheric plasma spraying (APS) before and after ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification (UNSM). The coatings were characterized using scanning electron microscopy and energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), together with microhardness, tribological, abrasive, erosive, impact-abrasive, cavitation, corrosion, oxidation, and valve endurance tests. The results demonstrate that the deposition technology strongly affects the coating structure and performance. UNSM produced a pronounced increase in microhardness, reaching 1468 HV for DS + UNSM, 1596 HV for HVOF + UNSM, and 1561 HV for APS + UNSM. Ultrasonic treatment also reduced material loss under abrasive, erosive, impact-abrasive, and cavitation conditions. APS + UNSM demonstrated the best performance in the principal laboratory wear tests, with the lowest abrasive mass loss (0.42–0.45 mg), erosive mass loss (0.55–0.60 mg), impact-abrasive mass loss (0.75–0.85 mg), and cavitation mass-loss rate (0.33–0.38 mg/h). In tribological testing, APS + UNSM exhibited the lowest coefficient of friction (0.28), compared with 0.32 for HVOF + UNSM and 0.36 for DS + UNSM. In valve endurance testing, HVOF + UNSM showed the lowest plunger displacement growth rate (0.050 mm/h) and the longest calculated time to reach the 2 mm displacement criterion (22 h). Overall, the combination of thermal spraying and UNSM improves the mechanical and service performance of WC–Co–Cr coatings, while the optimal coating condition depends on the specific degradation mechanism and operating conditions.

infographic.key_insight: Ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification (UNSM) substantially boosts the hardness and wear/corrosion-related performance of WC–Co–Cr thermal spray coatings, but the best spraying route depends on the failure mode.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For wear-critical steel components, pairing thermal spraying with UNSM can extend service life, yet coating selection should be matched to whether the main concern is abrasive wear, friction, cavitation, or valve endurance.
method: Deposited WC–Co–Cr coatings by detonation spraying (DS), HVOF, and APS.
Applied ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification (UNSM) to each coating condition.
Evaluated microstructure and performance using SEM/EDS, hardness, tribology, abrasion, erosion, impact-abrasion, cavitation, corrosion, oxidation, and valve endurance tests.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports clear performance shifts after UNSM, including hardness increases up to 1596 HV and the best wear-test results for APS+UNSM, while HVOF+UNSM gave the best valve endurance response.
infographic.watch_item: Performance gains are mechanism-specific, so the most improved coating in lab wear tests may not be the best choice for valve service or other real operating conditions.

zh-Hans.title: WC-Co-Cr热喷涂涂层的超声表面改性：显微组织、力学性能与服役性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 热喷涂WC–Co–Cr涂层广泛用于提高在严苛服役条件下运行的钢制部件的耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。本研究考察了通过爆炸喷涂（DS）、高速火焰喷涂（HVOF）和大气等离子喷涂（APS）制备的WC–Co–Cr涂层在超声纳米晶表面改性（UNSM）前后的性能。采用扫描电子显微镜和能量色散X射线光谱（SEM/EDS），并结合显微硬度、摩擦学、磨粒磨损、冲蚀、冲击磨粒磨损、空蚀、腐蚀、氧化和阀门耐久性测试对涂层进行了表征。结果表明，沉积技术显著影响涂层结构和性能。UNSM使显微硬度显著提高，DS + UNSM达到1468 HV，HVOF + UNSM达到1596 HV，APS + UNSM达到1561 HV。超声处理还降低了在磨粒、冲蚀、冲击磨粒和空蚀条件下的材料损失。APS + UNSM在主要实验室磨损测试中表现最佳，其磨粒质量损失最低（0.42–0.45 mg）、冲蚀质量损失最低（0.55–0.60 mg）、冲击磨粒质量损失最低（0.75–0.85 mg），以及空蚀质量损失速率最低（0.33–0.38 mg/h）。在摩擦学测试中，APS + UNSM表现出最低摩擦系数（0.28），相比之下，HVOF + UNSM为0.32，DS + UNSM为0.36。在阀门耐久性测试中，HVOF + UNSM表现出最低的柱塞位移增长率（0.050 mm/h），以及达到2 mm位移判据的最长计算时间（22 h）。总体而言，热喷涂与UNSM的组合可改善WC–Co–Cr涂层的力学和服役性能，而最佳涂层状态取决于具体的失效机制和运行条件。

infographic.key_insight: 超声纳米晶表面改性（UNSM）可显著提升WC–Co–Cr热喷涂涂层的硬度以及与磨损/腐蚀相关的性能，但最佳喷涂路线取决于失效模式。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于耐磨要求高的钢制部件，将热喷涂与UNSM结合可延长服役寿命，但涂层选择应与主要关注的失效机制相匹配，即磨粒磨损、摩擦、空蚀或阀门耐久性。
method: 采用爆炸喷涂（DS）、HVOF和APS制备WC–Co–Cr涂层。
对每种涂层状态施加超声纳米晶表面改性（UNSM）。
采用SEM/EDS、硬度、摩擦学、磨粒磨损、冲蚀、冲击磨粒磨损、空蚀、腐蚀、氧化和阀门耐久性测试评估显微组织和性能。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了UNSM后的明确性能变化，包括最高达1596 HV的硬度提升，以及APS+UNSM在磨损测试中的最佳结果，而HVOF+UNSM在阀门耐久性响应方面表现最佳。
infographic.watch_item: 性能提升具有机制特异性，因此在实验室磨损测试中表现最优的涂层，未必是阀门服役或其他实际工况下的最佳选择。

title: Few-Shot Welding Defect Detection via Graph Self-Attention Neural Network
authors: American Welding Society, Zhongyan Zhang, Weihao Shen, HAIPENG CUI, LUXI LIU, Rongdi Wang
abstract: In industrial quality control, deep learning-based weld defect detection has shown promise but is often hindered by the need for extensive labeled datasets. This study introduces a novel graph neural network (GNN) approach for few-shot classification of weld defect images, aimed at mitigating data dependence and enabling efficient defect detection in data-scarce environments. The goal is to achieve high accuracy with minimal labeled samples, reducing data collection costs and enabling applications in scenarios with limited annotated data. A GNN-based algorithm is designed that incorporates a patch mechanism to reduce computational complexity and a self-attention mechanism to enhance node feature representation. The model is evaluated on public datasets (Al5083 and SS304) using only 5% of the training data, and its performance is compared against the ResNet18 baseline. The proposed model achieves accuracies of 82.0% on Al5083 and 94.8% on SS304, outperforming ResNet18 by 5.2% and 2.4%, respectively. Results demonstrate strong generalization performance with limited training samples, validating the efficacy of the approach in few-shot settings. This work reduces dependency on large, annotated datasets, lowering the cost and effort of data collection in industrial environments. It provides a practical solution for high-precision detection of weld defects in data-scarce scenarios, with potential applications in specialized manufacturing contexts.

infographic.key_insight: A graph self-attention neural network can classify weld defects accurately from very few labeled images by exploiting patch-based graph features instead of relying on large training sets.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This offers a practical low-data inspection method for welding quality control, reducing annotation cost while preserving strong defect-detection performance in industrial settings.
method: Builds a graph neural network for weld image classification.
Uses patch-based node construction to reduce computation.
Adds self-attention to strengthen node feature representation.
infographic.evidence_signal: Evaluated on Al5083 and SS304 using only 5% of training data, the model achieved 82.0% and 94.8% accuracy, outperforming ResNet18 by 5.2% and 2.4% respectively.
infographic.watch_item: Performance is shown on public datasets with limited training splits, so real plant deployment may still require validation under domain shift, noise, and class imbalance.
infographic.paper_title: Few-Shot Welding Defect Detection via Graph Self-Attention Neural Network

zh-Hans.title: 基于图自注意力神经网络的少样本焊接缺陷检测
zh-Hans.abstract: 在工业质量控制中，基于深度学习的焊缝缺陷检测已展现出潜力，但常常受限于对大量标注数据集的需求。本研究提出一种用于焊接缺陷图像少样本分类的新型图神经网络（GNN）方法，旨在缓解对数据的依赖，并在数据稀缺环境中实现高效缺陷检测。研究目标是在最少标注样本的情况下实现高精度，降低数据采集成本，并支持标注数据有限场景下的应用。本文设计了一种基于GNN的算法，结合patch机制以降低计算复杂度，并通过自注意力机制增强节点特征表征。该模型在公共数据集（Al5083和SS304）上仅使用5%的训练数据进行评估，并与ResNet18基线进行比较。所提出的模型在Al5083和SS304上的准确率分别达到82.0%和94.8%，较ResNet18分别提升5.2%和2.4%。结果表明，该方法在有限训练样本下具有较强的泛化性能，验证了其在少样本场景中的有效性。该工作减少了对大规模标注数据集的依赖，降低了工业环境中数据采集的成本和工作量。它为数据稀缺场景下焊接缺陷的高精度检测提供了一种实用方案，并有望应用于特定制造场景。

infographic.key_insight: 图自注意力神经网络可以通过利用基于patch的图特征，而不是依赖大规模训练集，从极少量标注图像中准确分类焊接缺陷。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这为焊接质量控制提供了一种实用的低数据量检测方法，在保持较强缺陷检测性能的同时降低了工业场景中的标注成本。
method: 构建用于焊接图像分类的图神经网络。
采用基于patch的节点构建以降低计算量。
引入自注意力以增强节点特征表征。
infographic.evidence_signal: 在Al5083和SS304上仅使用5%的训练数据进行评估时，该模型分别达到82.0%和94.8%的准确率，较ResNet18分别高出5.2%和2.4%。
infographic.watch_item: 性能结果基于公开数据集和有限训练划分给出，因此在实际工厂部署中仍可能需要在域偏移、噪声和类别不平衡条件下进行验证。

title: Evaluation of the Corrosion Resistance of Welded Joints of Stainless-Clad 304/Q235B Bimetallic Steel Rectangle Tubes and 304 Stainless-Steel End Plates
authors: Jun ZHAO, Zhihao Cai, Yang Peng, Jun Dong
abstract: Abstract Stainless-clad bimetallic steel, which can balance corrosion resistance and economy, is becoming a new research hot spot in high-performance steel structures. This study focuses on rectangular tube components fabricated from stainless-clad 304/Q235B bimetallic steel plates (with 304 stainless cladding on the outer side) and closed by welding with 304 stainless-steel end plates. This design is to isolate the carbon steel base from corrosive media, achieving corrosion resistance close to that of all-stainless-steel structures. Three welding process schemes are proposed, and mechanical tests and indoor salt spray accelerated corrosion tests were conducted to evaluate the joints. Mechanical property tests show that the maximum hardness value of each joint does not exceed 280 vickers hardness (HV), and their microhardness meets engineering requirements. The joint with the process combination of shielded metal arc (SMA) welding + E309-16 electrode has the best mechanical properties, while the joint with the combination of tungsten inert gas (TIG) welding + ER308 welding wire has the best corrosion resistance. The indoor salt spray accelerated corrosion test indicates that welds promote the occurrence of corrosion, and the intersections of welds are the most susceptible parts to corrosion in tube joints. The weight loss fitting curve shows a power function characteristic, with the fitting coefficient R 2 > 0.98 and the exponent n < 1 , which indicates that the rust layer or passive film plays a partial protective role on the base material. The corrosion prediction model for the welded joints of stainless-clad 304/Q235B bimetallic steel rectangle tubes and 304 stainless-steel end plates in the marine atmospheric environment of Qingdao, China, is as follows: t = 34.9876 T 0.4441 . These findings provide a reference for promoting the application of stainless-clad steel plate structures.
venue: Journal of Materials in Civil Engineering

infographic.key_insight: Welded stainless-clad 304/Q235B rectangular tubes sealed with 304 stainless end plates can approach all-stainless corrosion performance, but weld design strongly controls both mechanical behavior and corrosion resistance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The results support using stainless-clad bimetallic steel for cost-effective corrosion-resistant structural components in marine and other aggressive environments.
method: Compared three welding process schemes for tube-to-end-plate joints.
Evaluated hardness/mechanical performance and indoor salt-spray accelerated corrosion behavior.
Fitted corrosion mass-loss data and built a marine-atmosphere corrosion prediction model.
infographic.evidence_signal: All joints had maximum hardness below 280 HV, the best corrosion resistance came from TIG + ER308, and the corrosion fit showed strong agreement (R² > 0.98) with a power-law trend.
infographic.watch_item: Weld intersections were the most corrosion-prone regions, so joint geometry, filler selection, and weld quality control remain critical for field deployment.
infographic.paper_title: Evaluation of the Corrosion Resistance of Welded Joints of Stainless-Clad 304/Q235B Bimetallic Steel Rectangle Tubes and 304 Stainless-Steel End Plates

zh-Hans.title: 不锈钢复合 304/Q235B 双金属钢矩形管与 304 不锈钢端板焊接接头耐腐蚀性评估
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 不锈钢复合双金属钢兼具耐腐蚀性与经济性，正成为高性能钢结构领域新的研究热点。本研究聚焦于采用不锈钢复合 304/Q235B 双金属钢板（外侧为 304 不锈钢复层）制作的矩形管构件，并通过与 304 不锈钢端板焊接封闭。该设计旨在将碳钢基材与腐蚀介质隔离，从而实现接近全不锈钢结构的耐腐蚀性能。提出了三种焊接工艺方案，并通过力学试验和室内盐雾加速腐蚀试验对接头进行评价。力学性能测试表明，各接头的最大硬度值均不超过 280 维氏硬度（HV），其显微硬度满足工程要求。采用焊条电弧焊（SMA）+ E309-16 焊条工艺组合的接头力学性能最好，而采用钨极惰性气体保护焊（TIG）+ ER308 焊丝组合的接头耐腐蚀性能最好。室内盐雾加速腐蚀试验表明，焊缝会促进腐蚀的发生，且焊缝交汇处是管接头中最易腐蚀的部位。失重拟合曲线呈幂函数特征，拟合系数 R2 > 0.98，指数 n < 1，表明锈层或钝化膜对基体材料具有部分保护作用。不锈钢复合 304/Q235B 双金属钢矩形管与 304 不锈钢端板焊接接头在中国青岛海洋大气环境中的腐蚀预测模型如下：t = 34.9876 T 0.4441。研究结果可为推动不锈钢复合钢板结构的应用提供参考。

infographic.key_insight: 采用 304 不锈钢端板封闭的不锈钢复合 304/Q235B 矩形管焊接结构，其耐腐蚀性能可接近全不锈钢结构，但焊接设计对力学行为和耐腐蚀性具有显著控制作用。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 研究结果支持在海洋及其他强腐蚀环境中使用不锈钢复合双金属钢作为具有成本效益的耐腐蚀结构构件。
method: 比较了管-端板接头的三种焊接工艺方案。
评估了硬度/力学性能及室内盐雾加速腐蚀行为。
拟合了腐蚀失重数据，并建立了海洋大气环境腐蚀预测模型。
infographic.evidence_signal: 所有接头的最大硬度均低于 280 HV，TIG + ER308 的耐腐蚀性能最佳，腐蚀拟合结果与幂律趋势具有良好一致性（R² > 0.98）。
infographic.watch_item: 焊缝交汇处是最易腐蚀区域，因此接头几何形状、填充材料选择和焊接质量控制在工程应用中仍然至关重要。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: A coupled CEL simulation and ANN surrogate can accurately predict friction stir welding quality in HDPE, revealing that bottom-surface preheating stabilizes force and temperature and improves weldability.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This work provides a practical process-optimization route for thermoplastic welding by linking physics-based modeling with fast machine-learning predictions to identify defect-free operating windows.
method: 3D coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) model of HDPE FSW under varied rotation speed, travel speed, and bottom preheating
Two multilayer perceptron ANNs trained on experimental time-series data for temperature and axial force prediction
Combined simulation-experiment process mapping to locate defective vs defect-free welding conditions
infographic.evidence_signal: The ANN models achieved strong agreement with experiments with R² values from 0.91 to 0.99, and the CEL model matched observed void formation and thermal/mechanical responses.
infographic.watch_item: The process map is based on a specific HDPE setup and tested parameter range, so broader transfer to other polymers, tool geometries, or thicknesses should be validated before deployment.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊接质量预测的计算与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）已被公认为一种有效的热塑性材料连接技术。本研究结合计算方法和机器学习方法，并通过实验结果验证，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊缝温度、竖向轴向力、材料流动和缺陷形成等特征进行了全面研究，以预测这些FSW特性。建立了三维耦合欧拉-拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，用于在不同工艺参数（转速、焊接速度以及底部预热条件）下模拟HDPE焊接过程。CEL数值模型与实验数据进行了验证，在预测孔洞形成以及热和力学响应方面表现出显著良好的一致性。结果表明，对底表面进行预热可有效减小热梯度并稳定竖向力波动。定量而言，底表面60 °C预热将峰值压入力从接近1600 N降至约1100 N，并将峰值温度从70 °C（无预热）提高到约100 °C，从而平滑了厚度方向梯度并稳定了轴向力分布。与此同时，基于实验数据训练了两个多层感知机人工神经网络（ANN），用于预测温度和轴向力的时变响应，其R2介于0.91至0.99之间，表明在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有很高的准确性和较强的泛化能力。计算CEL模拟能够准确预测焊区形貌，包括搅拌区、热-机影响区和热影响区；而CEL–ANN联合框架则可快速生成工艺图，标示出有缺陷和无缺陷的焊接窗口，其中在1500 rpm、30 mm/min并预热60 °C时获得了最优条件，而在无预热、1000 rpm条件下由于蠕虫孔形成而观察到较差的焊接性。这些发现为开发稳健的HDPE接头提供了基于工艺的设计指导，并展示了将计算建模与机器学习相结合如何实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料搅拌摩擦焊过程中的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，并支持其在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

infographic.key_insight: 耦合CEL模拟与ANN代理模型能够准确预测HDPE搅拌摩擦焊质量，表明底表面预热可稳定力和温度并改善焊接性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 本研究通过将基于物理的建模与快速机器学习预测相结合，为热塑性材料焊接提供了一条实用的工艺优化路径，用于识别无缺陷的操作窗口。
method: 在不同转速、行进速度和底部预热条件下，对HDPE搅拌摩擦焊建立三维耦合欧拉-拉格朗日（CEL）模型
基于实验时序数据训练两个多层感知机ANN，用于温度和轴向力预测
通过仿真-实验联合工艺映射确定有缺陷与无缺陷的焊接条件
infographic.evidence_signal: ANN模型与实验具有良好一致性，R²值范围为0.91至0.99；CEL模型与观测到的孔洞形成以及热/力学响应相匹配。
infographic.watch_item: 该工艺图基于特定的HDPE配置和测试参数范围，因此在应用于其他聚合物、工具几何形状或厚度之前，应先验证其更广泛的适用性。

title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments
authors: Roshan Kuruvila, Mebin T Kuruvila, Manu Harilal, S. Thirumalai Kumaran
abstract: Cermet coating, which is a blend of ceramic hardness and metallic toughness, is mostly applied to enhance the wear and corrosion resistance of metals. Detonation gun ( D -gun) spraying is one of the most promising thermal spray technologies that would produce a high-quality ceramic coating. Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr coating is acceptable because of its superior mechanical characteristics and corrosion characteristic. The effectiveness of D -gun sprayed Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings was evaluated under aggressive acidic conditions using 1 M H₂SO₄, which serves as a standardized laboratory electrolyte for assessing corrosion resistance relevant to industrial acidic environments, including the key process variables such as spraying distance, which is critically important in the determination of other coating properties such as porosity, adhesion, roughness, and hardness. Duplex stainless steel (DSS) 2205 has been sprayed with Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr at three spraying distances; 170 mm, 180 mm and 190 mm in an attempt to conduct the research on the behavior of Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr in acid conditions. Electrochemical activity of the coating was evaluated in 1 M H 2 SO 4 solutions at room temperature; by open circuit potential (OCP), electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and potentiodynamic polarisation. Investigation of surface morphology under SEM revealed dense lamellar coatings with porosity decreasing from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm, indicating improved particle melting and coating compactness. The coating deposited at 190 mm exhibited the best electrochemical performance, with lowest corrosion rate (0.113 mmpy), compared with the uncoated substrate (2.60 mmpy). All coated specimens had a homogenous and compact coating structure. The results demonstrate that 190 mm is the optimum spray distance for producing high-integrity Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205, providing enhanced corrosion protection for components operating in aggressive acidic industrial environments. This work demonstrates that optimizing the D -gun spray distance significantly influences the microstructural integrity and electrochemical corrosion behaviour of Cr₃C₂–25NiCr coatings on DSS 2205. The established processing–microstructure–performance relationship provides a scientific basis for optimizing D -gun coating parameters to enhance corrosion resistance in aggressive acidic environments.

infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing spray distance is a practical lever for improving coating integrity and extending the service life of stainless-steel components in acidic industrial environments.
method: D-gun spray Cr3C2–NiCr onto DSS 2205 at 170, 180, and 190 mm stand-off distances.
Characterize coating morphology/porosity by SEM.
Evaluate corrosion behavior in 1 M H2SO4 using OCP, EIS, and potentiodynamic polarization.
infographic.evidence_signal: Porosity decreased from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm, and the 190 mm coating showed the lowest corrosion rate (0.113 mmpy) versus 2.60 mmpy for the uncoated substrate.
infographic.watch_item: The optimum distance was determined under one electrolyte and room-temperature test conditions, so performance may differ under other acids, temperatures, or service wear conditions.

zh-Hans.title: D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层在酸性环境中对DSS 2205的喷涂距离影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 金属陶瓷涂层兼具陶瓷的高硬度和金属的韧性，主要用于提高金属的耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。爆炸喷涂（D-gun）是最具前景的热喷涂技术之一，可制备高质量陶瓷涂层。Cr3C2-NiCr涂层因其优异的力学性能和耐腐蚀性能而被认为是合适的。采用1 M H2SO4在强酸性条件下评估D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层的有效性，该溶液作为一种标准化实验室电解质，用于评估与工业酸性环境相关的耐腐蚀性；其中包括喷涂距离等关键工艺变量，而喷涂距离对孔隙率、结合强度、粗糙度和硬度等其他涂层性能的确定具有关键影响。将双相不锈钢（DSS）2205在170 mm、180 mm和190 mm三种喷涂距离下喷涂Cr3C2-NiCr，以研究Cr3C2-NiCr在酸性条件下的行为。通过开路电位（OCP）、电化学阻抗谱和动电位极化，在室温下对1 M H2SO4溶液中涂层的电化学活性进行了评估。SEM下的表面形貌研究表明，涂层致密且呈层状结构；孔隙率由170 mm时的2.84%降至190 mm时的1.38%，说明颗粒熔化更充分、涂层更致密。190 mm沉积的涂层表现出最佳电化学性能，其腐蚀速率最低（0.113 mmpy），而未涂覆基体的腐蚀速率为2.60 mmpy。所有涂覆试样均具有均匀致密的涂层结构。结果表明，190 mm是制备DSS 2205上高完整性Cr3C2–NiCr涂层的最佳喷涂距离，可为在强酸性工业环境中运行的部件提供更好的防腐保护。本研究表明，优化D-gun喷涂距离会显著影响DSS 2205上Cr3C2–25NiCr涂层的微观结构完整性和电化学腐蚀行为。所建立的工艺—微观结构—性能关系为优化D-gun涂层参数、提升强酸性环境下的耐腐蚀性提供了科学依据。

infographic.key_insight: 对于在1 M H2SO4中D-gun喷涂于DSS 2205上的Cr3C2–NiCr，190 mm喷涂距离获得了最致密的涂层和最佳的耐腐蚀性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化喷涂距离是改善涂层完整性、延长不锈钢部件在酸性工业环境中服役寿命的实用手段。
method: 在170、180和190 mm停留距离下，将Cr3C2–NiCr通过D-gun喷涂到DSS 2205上。
采用SEM表征涂层形貌/孔隙率。
使用OCP、EIS和动电位极化在1 M H2SO4中评估腐蚀行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: 孔隙率从170 mm时的2.84%降至190 mm时的1.38%，且190 mm涂层的腐蚀速率最低（0.113 mmpy），而未涂覆基体为2.60 mmpy。
infographic.watch_item: 最佳距离是在单一电解质和室温测试条件下确定的，因此在其他酸类、温度或服役磨损条件下性能可能不同。

title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Manarbek Kylyshkanov, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: The present study investigates the effect of flame-spraying process parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings. Corrosion-resistant AISI 321 austenitic chromium–nickel steel was used as the substrate material. The coatings were deposited by flame spraying using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system. To vary the thermal conditions of the spraying process, the oxygen-to-acetylene (O₂/C₂H₂) ratio was adjusted to 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. The spraying parameters were monitored using an Accuraspray 4.0 diagnostic system. The resulting coatings were characterized in terms of microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength. Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio resulted in densification of the coating structure and a decrease in porosity from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%. Concurrently, the surface roughness decreased from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, while the adhesion strength increased from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa. The highest average microhardness of 1051.7 HV was obtained at an O₂/C₂H₂ ratio of 1.1. Among the investigated spraying conditions, the coating produced at O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 exhibited the lowest porosity and surface roughness together with the highest adhesion strength. The results demonstrate that controlling the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio provides an effective means of tailoring the microstructural and mechanical characteristics of flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: Raising the flame-spraying O₂/C₂H₂ ratio densified Ni–Cr–B–Si self-fluxing coatings, lowering porosity and roughness while improving adhesion, with peak hardness at an intermediate ratio.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Tuning the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio is a practical process-control lever for optimizing protective coating quality on AISI 321 steel in industrial flame-spraying applications.
method: Flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si coatings onto AISI 321 austenitic stainless steel using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system.
Varied the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio at 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2 and monitored spraying with Accuraspray 4.0.
Measured microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports clear quantitative trends across the tested ratios: porosity dropped from 1.97% to 0.90%, roughness from 4.70 to 2.99 μm, and adhesion rose from 22.14 to 35.02 MPa, with maximum microhardness of 1051.7 HV at 1.1.
infographic.watch_item: The optimum depends on the target property: the highest hardness occurred at 1.1, while the best porosity/roughness/adhesion combination occurred at 1.2, so process settings must match the application goal.
infographic.paper_title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS

zh-Hans.title: 喷火温度对 Ni–Cr–B–Si 基自熔合金涂层性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了喷火工艺参数对 Ni–Cr–B–Si 基自熔合金涂层显微组织和力学性能的影响。采用耐腐蚀的 AISI 321 奥氏体铬镍钢作为基体材料。涂层通过使用 Metal Coat 6PM-II 系统进行喷火沉积。为改变喷涂过程的热条件，将氧/乙炔（O₂/C₂H₂）比调整为 1.0、1.1 和 1.2。喷涂参数使用 Accuraspray 4.0 诊断系统进行监测。对所得涂层的显微组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度进行了表征。随着 O₂/C₂H₂ 比的增加，涂层结构致密化，孔隙率由 1.97 ± 0.13% 降至 0.90 ± 0.09%。同时，表面粗糙度由 4.70 ± 0.09 μm 降至 2.99 ± 0.11 μm，而结合强度由 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa 提高到 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa。在 O₂/C₂H₂ 比为 1.1 时获得了最高平均显微硬度 1051.7 HV。在所研究的喷涂条件中，O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 制备的涂层表现出最低的孔隙率和表面粗糙度，同时具有最高的结合强度。结果表明，通过控制 O₂/C₂H₂ 比，可有效调控喷火沉积 Ni–Cr–B–Si 基自熔合金涂层的显微组织和力学特性。

infographic.key_insight: 提高喷火 O₂/C₂H₂ 比使 Ni–Cr–B–Si 自熔合金涂层更加致密，从而降低孔隙率和粗糙度、提高结合强度，而峰值硬度出现在中等比值下。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 调节 O₂/C₂H₂ 比是优化工业喷火应用中 AISI 321 钢表面防护涂层质量的一种实用工艺控制手段。
method: 使用 Metal Coat 6PM-II 系统将 Ni–Cr–B–Si 涂层喷火沉积到 AISI 321 奥氏体不锈钢上。
将 O₂/C₂H₂ 比分别设为 1.0、1.1 和 1.2，并使用 Accuraspray 4.0 监测喷涂过程。
测量显微组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了所测试比值下清晰的定量变化趋势：孔隙率从 1.97% 降至 0.90%，粗糙度从 4.70 μm 降至 2.99 μm，结合强度从 22.14 MPa 升至 35.02 MPa，并且在 1.1 时获得了 1051.7 HV 的最大显微硬度。
infographic.watch_item: 最优条件取决于目标性能：最高硬度出现在 1.1，而孔隙率/粗糙度/结合强度的最佳组合出现在 1.2，因此工艺设置必须与应用目标相匹配。

title: TAGUCHI-BASED OPTIMIZATION OF GMAW WELDING PARAMETERS FOR JOINT STRENGTH
authors: Innocent Mapindu, Destine Mashava, Vongai Shangwa, Tecclar Tarisai Chigavazira-Gwara, Gilbert Munhuwamambo
abstract: There is a set of process variables that defines the quality of a gas metal arc weld (GMAW) joint. The iteration of these process variables to find the optimum setting is time-consuming and does not have a statistical basis. The Taguchi method of robust parameter design is used to determine the optimum combination of welding current, arc voltage, shielding gas flow rate and travel speed to maximize the transverse tensile strength and minimize the weld defect count of mild-steel GMAW joints. Three replicates per trial (27 specimens) were used in a 3²7 experiment designed by a 4 factor 3 level L9(3⁴) orthogonal array.This was a 3²7 experiment using 3 replicates per trial in the form of an L9 (3⁴) orthogonal array. To estimate the influence of the factors and to determine single response optima, signal-to-noise (S/N) ratios, analysis of variance (ANOVA) and response-table analysis were used, and grey relational analysis (GRA) was applied to solve the conflict between the two response optima in order to select a compromise set of parameters. Of the 12 factors evaluated, the current and the arc voltage were found to be the most significant factors for both responses, contributing 35.28% and 31.06% of the variance in tensile strength, respectively, and 25.47% and 21.72% of the variance in number of defects, respectively, and for both responses were statistically significant at 1% level. Based on the GRA-based compromise optimum of 220 A / 24 V / 15 L/min / 350 mm/min, the tensile strength of 534.4 MPa with an acceptable defect level is predicted. The methodology, equations, and complete statistical processing are explained in detail in this paper, so that the study can be directly repeated using data measured in the laboratory
venue: World Journal of Advanced Engineering Technology and Sciences

infographic.key_insight: Taguchi-based design identified current and arc voltage as the dominant controls for optimizing GMAW joint strength while balancing weld defects via grey relational analysis.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study provides a repeatable statistical workflow for selecting welding settings that improve tensile performance and process robustness in mild-steel GMAW.
method: L9(3^4) Taguchi orthogonal array with 3 replicates per trial (27 specimens)
Signal-to-noise ratios, response tables, and ANOVA to rank factor effects
Grey relational analysis to combine tensile strength and defect count into a compromise optimum
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports that welding current and arc voltage were statistically significant at the 1% level, explaining the largest variance shares in both tensile strength and defect count.
infographic.watch_item: The optimum is based on the tested factor ranges and a laboratory dataset, so performance may shift if joint design, material, or machine setup changes.
infographic.paper_title: TAGUCHI-BASED OPTIMIZATION OF GMAW WELDING PARAMETERS FOR JOINT STRENGTH

zh-Hans.title: 基于田口法的GMAW焊接参数优化以提高接头强度
zh-Hans.abstract: 决定气体金属极电弧焊（GMAW）接头质量的是一组工艺变量。通过迭代这些工艺变量来寻找最优设置既耗时，又缺乏统计学依据。采用田口稳健参数设计方法，确定焊接电流、电弧电压、保护气体流量和焊接速度的最优组合，以最大化低碳钢GMAW接头的横向拉伸强度并最小化焊接缺陷数。该研究采用四因素三水平的L9(3^4)正交表进行3²7实验，每个试验设置3个重复样本（共27个试样）。这是一个采用L9(3^4)正交表、每个试验3次重复的3²7实验。为估计各因素的影响并确定单响应最优值，使用了信噪比（S/N）、方差分析（ANOVA）和响应表分析；同时应用灰色关联分析（GRA）解决两个响应最优值之间的冲突，以选取折中参数组合。在所评估的12个因素中，电流和电弧电压被发现是两个响应中最显著的因素，分别贡献了拉伸强度方差的35.28%和31.06%，以及缺陷数方差的25.47%和21.72%，且在两个响应中均达到1%显著性水平。基于GRA得到的折中最优参数220 A / 24 V / 15 L/min / 350 mm/min，预测可获得534.4 MPa的拉伸强度，并具有可接受的缺陷水平。本文详细说明了该方法、相关方程及完整统计处理过程，以便可直接使用实验室测得的数据重复该研究。

infographic.key_insight: 基于田口法的设计识别出电流和电弧电压是优化GMAW接头强度的主导控制因素，同时通过灰色关联分析平衡焊接缺陷。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究提供了一套可重复的统计流程，用于选择可改善低碳钢GMAW拉伸性能和工艺稳健性的焊接参数。
method: 采用L9(3^4)田口正交表，每个试验3次重复（27个试样）
使用信噪比、响应表和方差分析（ANOVA）对因素效应进行排序
采用灰色关联分析将拉伸强度和缺陷数合并为折中最优解
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告称，焊接电流和电弧电压在1%显著性水平上具有统计显著性，并解释了拉伸强度和缺陷数中最大的方差贡献。
infographic.watch_item: 该最优解基于所测试的因素范围和实验室数据集，因此当接头设计、材料或设备设置发生变化时，性能可能会改变。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.key_insight: Among WC-10Co-4Cr coatings, higher-velocity spray processes produced denser, harder coatings with markedly better wear and corrosion performance than APS, with HVAF generally best overall.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For wear- and corrosion-critical components on stainless steel, HVOF and HVAF offer the strongest coating performance tradeoff, making them strong candidates for industrial surface protection.
method: WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were deposited on 304 stainless steel using APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF.
Microstructure, hardness, wear behavior, friction coefficient, and electrochemical corrosion resistance were compared.
Performance ranking was established from tribological tests and corrosion measurements.
infographic.evidence_signal: Hardness increased from 771.4 HV (APS) to 1166.2 HV (HVOF) and 1162.2 HV (HVAF), while wear rate dropped from 7.93×10^-5 mm3/N·m (APS) to 1.17×10^-5 (HVOF) and 1.10×10^-5 (HVAF), with HVAF also showing the best corrosion metrics.
infographic.watch_item: Results are specific to this coating chemistry, substrate, and test conditions, so process selection should still consider thermal stress, residual porosity, and service environment.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、高速氧燃料喷涂和高速空气燃料喷涂 WC-10Co-4Cr 硬质合金涂层的显微组织、耐磨性与耐腐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr 硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性能和耐腐蚀性能。分别采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOFS）和高速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，在 304 不锈钢基体上制备 WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层。系统研究并比较了 WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层的显微组织、摩擦学性能和耐腐蚀性能。结果表明，采用 APS、DS、HVOF 和 HVAF 制备的硬质合金涂层的维氏硬度均高于 304 不锈钢，其值分别为 771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV 和 1162.2 HV。304 不锈钢的体积磨损率约为 (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m。APS、DS、HVOF 和 HVAF 涂层的体积磨损率均低于 304 不锈钢，分别约为 (7.93±0.30)×10-5、(1.51±0.20)×10-5、(1.17±0.10)×10-5 和 (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m。此外，304 不锈钢基体、APS 涂层、DS 涂层、HVOF 涂层和 HVAF 涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为 (0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01) 和 (0.43±0.01)。WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层的磨痕中可观察到剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是这些硬质合金涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF 和 HVAF 涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主体。随后，后三种涂层的耐磨性均优于 APS 涂层。此外，HVOF 和 HVAF 涂层表现出更好的耐磨性能。耐腐蚀性能由高到低依次为 HVAF 涂层、DS 涂层、HVOF 涂层和 APS 涂层。本文中，HVAF 涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位（-0.37±0.01 VSCE）、最小的腐蚀电流密度（1.75±0.02 μA/cm²）和最大的耐腐蚀阻抗（20438.5 Ω）。在这四种涂层中，APS 涂层的耐腐蚀性最差。

infographic.key_insight: 在 WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层中，更高速度的喷涂工艺制备出更致密、更高硬度的涂层，其耐磨和耐腐蚀性能均显著优于 APS，其中 HVAF 综合表现通常最佳。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于不锈钢上耐磨和耐腐蚀要求严苛的部件，HVOF 和 HVAF 具有最强的涂层性能平衡，是工业表面防护的有力候选工艺。
method: 采用 APS、DS、HVOF 和 HVAF 在 304 不锈钢上沉积 WC-10Co-4Cr 涂层。
比较了显微组织、硬度、磨损行为、摩擦系数和电化学腐蚀性能。
基于摩擦学试验和腐蚀测量建立了性能排序。
infographic.evidence_signal: 硬度从 771.4 HV（APS）提高到 1166.2 HV（HVOF）和 1162.2 HV（HVAF），而磨损率从 7.93×10^-5 mm3/N·m（APS）降至 1.17×10^-5（HVOF）和 1.10×10^-5（HVAF），同时 HVAF 也表现出最佳腐蚀指标。
infographic.watch_item: 结果仅适用于该涂层化学成分、基体和测试条件，因此工艺选择仍应考虑热应力、残余孔隙率和服役环境。

title: Explainable Temporal Attention-based Defect Detection For Fillet Joints in Real-Time Gas Metal Arc Welding Based on Multi-modal Data
authors: Mobina Mobaraki, Mahyar Asadi, Klaske Van Heusden, Guy A. Dumont
abstract: Deep learning is an efficient technique to monitor the real time welding process, reducing post-welding repairs and production delays. This paper leverages the monitoring capability by proposing a multi modal temporal attention based deep learning defect detection model for internal defects that are challenging to detect, including porosity, lack of penetration and fusion, undercut, and cold lap during Gas Metal Arc Welding in fillet joints. The model is trained on collected welding images and sound data from an industrial collaborative welding robot. The results show that the attention module can improve the F1 Score to 0.99. We use explainable Artificial Intelligence to interpret the proposed models behavior and dataset distribution, determining potential important areas in image and sound spectrograms and preferred modality to detect each defect. This improves trust and reliability in Artificial Intelligence driven welding inspection.

infographic.key_insight: A multimodal temporal-attention deep learning model can detect hard-to-see welding defects in real time from synchronized images and sound, while also explaining which signals drive each prediction.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This enables more reliable in-line quality control for fillet-joint gas metal arc welding, reducing rework, production delays, and missed internal defects.
method: Trained a temporal attention-based deep learning classifier on welding images and acoustic data from an industrial collaborative robot.
Targeted internal defect classes including porosity, lack of penetration/fusion, undercut, and cold lap.
Used explainable AI to identify important regions in images and spectrograms and to compare modality usefulness by defect type.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports that the attention module improved the F1 score to 0.99 on the collected multimodal welding dataset.
infographic.watch_item: Performance is reported on a specific industrial setup, so generalization to other weld geometries, materials, sensors, or shop-floor noise conditions may require recalibration.
infographic.paper_title: Explainable Temporal Attention-based Defect Detection For Fillet Joints in Real-Time Gas Metal Arc Welding Based on Multi-modal Data

zh-Hans.title: 基于多模态数据的实时气体保护金属电弧焊角接接头可解释时间注意力缺陷检测
zh-Hans.abstract: 深度学习是一种用于监测实时焊接过程的高效技术，可减少焊后返修和生产延误。本文利用该监测能力，提出了一种基于多模态时间注意力的深度学习缺陷检测模型，用于识别在气体保护金属电弧焊角接接头中难以检测的内部缺陷，包括气孔、未焊透和未熔合、咬边以及冷搭。该模型基于从工业协作焊接机器人采集的焊接图像和声音数据进行训练。结果表明，注意力模块可将 F1 Score 提升至 0.99。我们采用可解释人工智能（Explainable Artificial Intelligence）来解析所提出模型的行为和数据集分布，确定图像和声音频谱图中的潜在重要区域，以及用于检测各类缺陷的优选模态。这提高了人工智能驱动焊接检测的可信度和可靠性。

infographic.key_insight: 一种多模态时间注意力深度学习模型能够利用同步图像和声音实时检测难以观察的焊接缺陷，同时解释哪些信号驱动了每次预测。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这使角接接头气体保护金属电弧焊能够实现更可靠的在线质量控制，减少返工、生产延误和内部缺陷漏检。
method: 基于工业协作机器人采集的焊接图像和声学数据训练时间注意力深度学习分类器。
针对包括气孔、未焊透/未熔合、咬边和冷搭在内的内部缺陷类别。
使用可解释人工智能识别图像和频谱图中的重要区域，并按缺陷类型比较各模态的有效性。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告称，注意力模块在所采集的多模态焊接数据集上将 F1 score 提升至 0.99。
infographic.watch_item: 该性能结果基于特定工业场景，因此在其他焊缝几何形状、材料、传感器或车间噪声条件下的泛化可能需要重新校准。

title: HARDNESS AND POST-SCRATCH SURFACE MORPHOLOGY OF Cr₃C₂–NiCr COATINGS AFTER ULTRASONIC NANOCRYSTAL SURFACE MODIFICATION
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, Indira Abizhanova, M.K. Kaliaskarova, Yermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов
abstract: The hardness and post-scratch surface morphology of Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings subjected to ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification (UNSM) were examined for detonation-sprayed (DS) and high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) deposits. Four treated samples per deposition route were evaluated at static loads of 20 and 30 N and vibration amplitudes of 20 and 30 µm. Instrumental hardness was measured at a load of 300 mN with a dwell time of 10 s. The DS samples exhibited hardness values of 820–970 HV, whereas the HVOF samples covered the wider range of 546–1165 HV. The highest values were recorded for DS-T1 at 20 N/20 µm and HVOF-T4 at 30 N/30 µm. SEM fields acquired after scratch testing showed heterogeneous surface contrast and crack-like discontinuities in both coating series. These observations provide qualitative evidence of the post-test surface condition but do not isolate damage caused by UNSM or establish a ranking of scratch resistance. Available mean friction coefficients are reported as supplementary observations for six treated samples. The results demonstrate a sample-dependent hardness response and emphasize the need to assess local mechanical properties together with surface integrity.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

infographic.key_insight: UNSM changed the local hardness of Cr3C2–NiCr coatings in a strongly sample-dependent way, with detonation-sprayed samples showing 820–970 HV and HVOF samples spanning a much wider 546–1165 HV range.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study indicates that post-spray surface modification can significantly alter near-surface mechanical performance of wear-resistant coatings, but process settings must be tuned separately for each deposition route.
method: Compared detonation-sprayed (DS) and HVOF Cr3C2–NiCr coatings after ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification (UNSM).
Tested four treated samples per route at 20/30 N static load and 20/30 µm vibration amplitude.
Measured instrumental hardness at 300 mN load with 10 s dwell and inspected scratch-induced surfaces by SEM.
infographic.evidence_signal: Hardness values and post-scratch SEM observations were reported for the treated coatings, with the highest hardness seen in DS-T1 at 20 N/20 µm and HVOF-T4 at 30 N/30 µm.
infographic.watch_item: Scratch SEM images show qualitative damage features, but the abstract does not establish a causal ranking of scratch resistance or separate UNSM effects from pre-existing coating differences.
infographic.paper_title: HARDNESS AND POST-SCRATCH SURFACE MORPHOLOGY OF Cr₃C₂–NiCr COATINGS AFTER ULTRASONIC NANOCRYSTAL SURFACE MODIFICATION

zh-Hans.title: Cr₃C₂–NiCr 涂层在超声纳米晶表面改性后的硬度与划痕后表面形貌
zh-Hans.abstract: 对经超声纳米晶表面改性（UNSM）处理的 Cr₃C₂–NiCr 涂层进行了硬度和划痕后表面形貌研究，样品分别来自爆炸喷涂（DS）和高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOF）沉积。每种沉积工艺评估了 4 个处理样品，静载荷分别为 20 和 30 N，振动幅值分别为 20 和 30 µm。采用 300 mN 载荷、10 s 保载时间测量仪器硬度。DS 样品的硬度值为 820–970 HV，而 HVOF 样品的范围更宽，为 546–1165 HV。最高值分别出现在 DS-T1（20 N/20 µm）和 HVOF-T4（30 N/30 µm）。划痕测试后获得的 SEM 区域显示，两组涂层均存在非均匀的表面对比度和类裂纹不连续特征。这些观察为测试后的表面状态提供了定性证据，但不能将损伤归因于 UNSM，亦不能建立划痕抗力的排序。可获得的平均摩擦系数作为 6 个处理样品的补充观察结果予以报告。结果表明，硬度响应具有明显的样品依赖性，并强调需要将局部力学性能与表面完整性结合评估。

infographic.key_insight: UNSM 以强烈的样品依赖方式改变了 Cr3C2–NiCr 涂层的局部硬度，其中爆炸喷涂样品为 820–970 HV，而 HVOF 样品的范围更宽，为 546–1165 HV。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 研究表明，喷涂后的表面改性可显著改变耐磨涂层近表面的力学性能，但工艺参数必须针对不同沉积路线分别优化。
method: 比较了经超声纳米晶表面改性（UNSM）后的爆炸喷涂（DS）与 HVOF Cr3C2–NiCr 涂层。
每种工艺路线测试了 4 个处理样品，静载荷为 20/30 N，振动幅值为 20/30 µm。
采用 300 mN 载荷和 10 s 保载时间测量仪器硬度，并通过 SEM 检查划痕诱导表面。
infographic.evidence_signal: 报告了处理后涂层的硬度值及划痕后 SEM 观察结果，其中最高硬度出现在 DS-T1（20 N/20 µm）和 HVOF-T4（30 N/30 µm）。
infographic.watch_item: 划痕 SEM 图像显示了定性的损伤特征，但摘要未建立划痕抗力的因果排序，也未将 UNSM 效应与涂层既有差异区分开来。

title: Acoustic Emission Metrology for Real-Time TIG Welding Monitoring: Spectral Characterization and Interpretability via Explainable AI
authors: Nandakumar Balakrishnan, A. Sumesh, Binoy B. Nair, P. Krishnakumar, Dinu Thomas Thekkuden, Jithin Edacheri Veetil
abstract: Tungsten inert gas (TIG) welding of AA5083 aluminum alloy is sensitive to heat input and shielding conditions, which can lead to defects such as porosity and burn-through that compromise weld quality. Conventional non-destructive testing methods are generally performed after welding and therefore provide limited capability for real-time process monitoring. This study presents an acoustic emission (AE)-based frequency-domain framework for real-time classification of weld conditions during TIG welding of AA5083. Acoustic signals were acquired at a sampling rate of 10 kHz and transformed into frequency-domain representations using the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). Decision Tree (DT), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Artificial Neural Network (ANN), and ensemble-learning classifiers were evaluated using the resulting spectral features. To address the high dimensionality of the FFT representation, Principal Component Analysis (PCA) was incorporated into the modeling workflow, with the retained components determined from the model-development data. Five-fold cross-validation and grid-search-based hyperparameter tuning were used during model development, while an independent test set was reserved for final evaluation. The best-performing classifiers achieved a classification accuracy of approximately 0.99 for distinguishing good-weld, porosity, and burn-through conditions. Weld-condition labels were independently validated using visual inspection and radiographic testing. FFT and Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT) analyses were used to characterize global and time-dependent spectral behavior, respectively, while SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) were employed to identify frequency regions contributing to model predictions. A comparative analysis with time-domain statistical features further demonstrated the stronger discriminative capability of the FFT-derived representation under the investigated conditions. The proposed framework combines high classification performance with interpretable frequency-domain information and provides a basis for in-process weld-condition monitoring and quality control of TIG-welded AA5083.

infographic.key_insight: FFT-based acoustic emission features let an explainable AI pipeline distinguish good welds, porosity, and burn-through in TIG welding with near-perfect accuracy.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This enables real-time, non-destructive weld-condition monitoring for AA5083, supporting faster quality control and defect detection during production.
method: Acoustic emission was sampled at 10 kHz and converted to frequency-domain features using FFT; STFT was used to inspect time-varying behavior.
Decision Tree, SVM, ANN, and ensemble classifiers were trained on spectral features, with PCA used to reduce FFT dimensionality.
Five-fold cross-validation and grid-search tuning were used, and SHAP highlighted the most influential frequency bands.
infographic.evidence_signal: Using independently verified weld labels and a reserved test set, the best models achieved about 0.99 classification accuracy for three weld states.
infographic.watch_item: Performance was demonstrated on a specific alloy and setup, so broader robustness across other welding parameters, sensors, and shop-floor noise still needs validation.
infographic.paper_title: Acoustic Emission Metrology for Real-Time TIG Welding Monitoring: Spectral Characterization and Interpretability via Explainable AI

zh-Hans.title: 用于实时TIG焊接监测的声发射计量学：谱特征表征与可解释人工智能解析
zh-Hans.abstract: AA5083铝合金的钨极惰性气体（TIG）焊接对热输入和保护条件较为敏感，可能导致气孔和烧穿等缺陷，从而损害焊缝质量。传统无损检测方法通常在焊后进行，因此对实时过程监测的能力有限。本研究提出一种基于声发射（AE）的频域框架，用于在TIG焊接AA5083过程中对焊接状态进行实时分类。声学信号以10 kHz的采样率采集，并通过快速傅里叶变换（FFT）转换为频域表示。基于所得谱特征，评估了决策树（DT）、支持向量机（SVM）、人工神经网络（ANN）以及集成学习分类器。为应对FFT表示的高维性，将主成分分析（PCA）纳入建模流程，其保留分量由模型开发数据确定。模型开发过程中采用五折交叉验证和基于网格搜索的超参数调优，而独立测试集则保留用于最终评估。表现最佳的分类器在区分良好焊缝、气孔和烧穿状态时达到了约0.99的分类准确率。焊接状态标签通过目视检查和射线检测进行了独立验证。分别采用FFT和短时傅里叶变换（STFT）分析全局和时变谱行为，同时使用SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）识别对模型预测有贡献的频率区域。与时域统计特征的比较分析进一步表明，在所研究条件下，FFT衍生表示具有更强的判别能力。所提出的框架将较高的分类性能与可解释的频域信息相结合，为TIG焊接AA5083的过程内焊接状态监测和质量控制提供了基础。

infographic.key_insight: 基于FFT的声发射特征使可解释人工智能流程能够以接近完美的准确率区分TIG焊接中的良好焊缝、气孔和烧穿。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这使得对AA5083进行实时、无损的焊接状态监测成为可能，从而支持生产过程中的更快质量控制和缺陷检测。
method: 声发射以10 kHz采样，并使用FFT转换为频域特征；同时采用STFT检查时变行为。
在谱特征上训练了决策树、SVM、ANN和集成分类器，并使用PCA降低FFT维度。
采用五折交叉验证和网格搜索调参，并使用SHAP突出最具影响力的频带。
infographic.evidence_signal: 使用独立验证的焊接标签和保留测试集，最佳模型在三种焊接状态上的分类准确率约为0.99。
infographic.watch_item: 该性能是在特定合金和装置上得到的，因此在其他焊接参数、传感器和车间噪声条件下的更广泛鲁棒性仍需验证。

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.key_insight: Laser power, welding speed, and TIG current jointly control molten-pool flow, penetration, and arc stability in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The results provide process guidance for tuning hybrid-welding parameters to improve weld geometry and arc behavior in low-expansion Invar steel components.
method: Numerical simulation of molten-pool dynamics
High-speed photography of arc and pool behavior
Parameter sweep over laser power, welding speed, and welding current
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports simulation and imaging evidence across laser power (5–6 kW), speed (0.5–0.8 m/min), and current (150–170 A) showing consistent changes in penetration depth, weld width, flow intensity, and arc deformation/stability.
infographic.watch_item: The findings are parameter-range specific, so process windows may need revalidation for different joint geometries, thicknesses, or equipment setups.
infographic.paper_title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel

zh-Hans.title: Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊中熔池动态行为与电弧特性
zh-Hans.abstract: Invar钢具有极低的热膨胀系数，因此被广泛用于航空航天复合材料模具制造。现有研究大多集中于工艺方面，对熔池流体动力学行为缺乏深入分析。因此，采用数值模拟和高速摄影分析了激光-TIG复合焊Invar钢过程中不同工艺参数对熔池形貌演变和电弧特性的影响，这为Invar钢焊接工艺优化提供了重要的理论支持。结果表明，在5 ~ 6 kW的激光功率范围内，功率增加会导致更大的回弹压力，从而促进更大的熔深和小孔尺寸，强化整体熔池流动，并使电弧在高功率下更易受到激光吸引而发生偏转。在0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min的焊接速度范围内，更高的速度会降低热输入，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，并使熔池流动速度和冷却速率增加；此外，电弧在高速度下更易发生变形。在150 ~ 170 A的焊接电流范围内，电流增加会增强电弧力，促进焊缝宽度扩展并强化熔池对流；此外，高电流下电弧更稳定。

infographic.key_insight: 激光功率、焊接速度和TIG电流共同控制激光-TIG复合焊Invar钢时的熔池流动、熔深和电弧稳定性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些结果为调节复合焊参数以改善低膨胀Invar钢构件的焊缝几何形状和电弧行为提供了工艺指导。
method: 熔池动力学数值模拟

title: Microstructure and wear properties of Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings sprayed by conventional and supersonic high-velocity atmospheric plasma spraying with axial powder feeding
authors: Tadeusz Kubaszek, Anita Słyś, Marek Góral, Marcin Drajewicz, Kamil Gancarczyk
abstract: This study investigated the microstructural evolution and phase transformation mechanisms in Cr₃C₂-NiCr cermet coatings (Metco 5241 powder) plasma-sprayed onto S235 steel substrates.Two technologies were used: conventional atmospheric plasma spraying (APS) with radial powder injection (single-electrode A60 torch) and supersonic plasma spraying with axial powder feeding (HV-APS, three-electrode Axial III torch).The HV-APS coatings exhibited nearly halved porosity (6.16% vs. 11.99% for APS) and significantly higher microhardness (1141 HV0.2 vs. 897 HV0.2).Phase analysis revealed the disappearance of primary Cr 3 C 2 and Cr 21.26 Ni 1.74 C 6 carbides in favour of supersaturated Cr-Ni solid solutions.In the erosion tests conducted at a 90° impact angle, the two coating variants exhibited nearly identical specific erosion rates (0.20 mg/g for APS and 0.19 mg/g for HV-APS) and comparable damage mechanisms, dominated by fatigue-driven lamellar spalling and brittle fracture.However, in tribological tests (ball-on-disc, 30 N load), HV-APS coatings showed nearly 27% lower wear volume (2.85 mm 3 ) and a reduced specific wear rate (1.90 × 10 -4 mm 3 /Nm) compared to APS (3.90 mm 3 and 2.60 × 10 -4 mm 3 /Nm, respectively), correlating with their higher density and hardness.The obtained results confirm that the use of axial powder feeding in supersonic HV-APS plasma spraying significantly improves the mechanical and tribological properties of Cr₃C₂-NiCr coatings, although this advantage is not evident in the erosion tests at high impact angles.
venue: Advances in Science and Technology – Research Journal

infographic.key_insight: Supersonic HV-APS with axial powder feeding produces denser, harder Cr3C2–NiCr coatings than conventional APS, but the erosion resistance at 90° impact remains nearly unchanged.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For wear-critical coatings, axial-feed HV-APS is a practical route to improve hardness and sliding wear performance without expecting a corresponding gain in high-angle erosion resistance.

infographic.watch_item: The improved density and tribological performance do not translate to better erosion resistance under 90° impact, so application-specific validation is still required.

zh-Hans.title: 采用常规及带轴向送粉的超音速高速大气等离子喷涂制备的Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的显微组织和磨损性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了喷涂于S235钢基体上的Cr₃C₂-NiCr金属陶瓷涂层（Metco 5241粉末）的显微组织演变和相变机制。采用了两种技术：具有径向送粉的常规大气等离子喷涂（APS，单电极A60炬）以及具有轴向送粉的超音速等离子喷涂（HV-APS，三电极Axial III炬）。HV-APS涂层的孔隙率几乎降低了一半（6.16% 对 11.99%，APS），且显微硬度显著更高（1141 HV0.2 对 897 HV0.2）。相分析表明，初生Cr 3 C 2 和Cr 21.26 Ni 1.74 C 6 碳化物消失，转而形成过饱和Cr-Ni固溶体。在90°冲击角下进行的冲蚀试验中，两种涂层的比冲蚀率几乎相同（APS为0.20 mg/g，HV-APS为0.19 mg/g），且损伤机制相近，主要表现为疲劳驱动的层片剥落和脆性断裂。然而，在摩擦学试验（球-盘，30 N载荷）中，与APS（分别为3.90 mm 3 和2.60 × 10 -4 mm 3 /Nm）相比，HV-APS涂层的磨损体积几乎降低了27%（2.85 mm 3 ），比磨损率也更低（1.90 × 10 -4 mm 3 /Nm），这与其更高的致密性和硬度相关。所得结果证实，在超音速HV-APS等离子喷涂中采用轴向送粉可显著改善Cr₃C₂-NiCr涂层的力学和摩擦学性能，但这种优势在高冲击角冲蚀试验中并不明显。

title: Effect of thermal exposure on the wear and phase stability of HVOF-deposited WC-17Co coatings
authors: Shreyas Yogeshwara, Pratibha Sinha, Basavaraja P. K, Vishwanath Managuli, Arun Kumar Jalan, Mallaiah Manjaiah
abstract: Wear-induced material loss is a major concern in industrial applications, driving the development of wear-resistant surface coatings. High-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) spraying is widely used to deposit coatings with high bond strength, low porosity, and improved wear resistance. Among these, WC–Co cermet coatings exhibit excellent hardness and tribological performance; however, wear behaviour can change significantly at elevated temperatures. The present study investigates the dry sliding wear behaviour of HVOF-deposited WC–17Co coatings from RT to 600 °C under constant load, sliding velocity, test duration, and sliding distance. The coatings were characterized before and after wear testing using SEM, EDS, XRD, and 3D surface profilometry to evaluate changes in morphology, elemental distribution, phase composition, and wear-track geometry. The coating showed a thickness of ~268.99 µm, 1.53% porosity, and an average surface roughness (Sa) of 10.2 µm. The coating showed favourable wear resistance at 200–400 °C, with minimum wear and friction at 400 °C likely due to a protective tribo-oxide layer and compacted debris. Above 400 °C, particularly at 500 and 600 °C, the wear rate increased markedly because of Co binder-phase degradation, intensified oxidation, and reduced adherence of the oxide layer, and the optimal operating range is 200–400 °C.

infographic.key_insight: HVOF WC-17Co coatings retain their best dry sliding wear performance at 200–400 °C, with a peak at 400 °C due to a protective tribo-oxide layer and compacted debris.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This suggests WC-17Co HVOF coatings can be used in moderately high-temperature wear environments, but performance degrades sharply above 400 °C as oxidation and binder damage accelerate.

zh-Hans.abstract: 磨损引起的材料损失是工业应用中的一个主要问题，推动了耐磨表面涂层的发展。高速火焰喷涂（HVOF）被广泛用于制备具有高结合强度、低孔隙率和更优耐磨性的涂层。在这些涂层中，WC–Co金属陶瓷涂层表现出优异的硬度和摩擦学性能；然而，在高温下其磨损行为可能发生显著变化。本研究考察了HVOF沉积WC–17Co涂层在恒定载荷、滑动速度、试验时间和滑动距离条件下，从室温（RT）到600 °C的干滑动磨损行为。采用SEM、EDS、XRD和三维表面轮廓测量对磨损试验前后的涂层进行表征，以评估形貌、元素分布、相组成和磨痕几何的变化。该涂层厚度约为268.99 µm，孔隙率为1.53%，平均表面粗糙度（Sa）为10.2 µm。该涂层在200–400 °C范围内表现出良好的耐磨性，其中400 °C时磨损和摩擦最小，这可能归因于保护性的摩擦氧化层和压实磨屑的作用。超过400 °C，尤其是在500和600 °C时，由于Co黏结相劣化、氧化加剧以及氧化层附着性降低，磨损率显著增加，因此最佳工作温度范围为200–400 °C。

title: Welding Techniques for Magnesium Alloy Joints: A Comprehensive Review
authors: Miloš Poliak, P. Czyżewski, Przemysłąw Kubiak, Damian Paweł Frej, Adam Rylski, Marek Woźniak
abstract: Magnesium (Mg) alloys are crucial for lightweight automotive design, underscoring the need for effective welding despite their poor weldability and susceptibility to defects such as cracks. The paper was prepared by reviewing available scientific databases of studies and patents using appropriate keywords. It reviews the properties, applications, and welding methods (fusion, friction, diffusion, explosive, and hybrid) of Mg alloys, assessing their advantages, disadvantages, and precautions. The importance of understanding the mechanical behavior and structural integrity of welded joints was highlighted. The impact of process variables on weld microstructure and properties, along with future research areas, is also addressed. AZ-series Mg alloys were found to be favored for weldability. For them, primary welding methods include GTAW, GMAW, LBW, and FSW. Trends emphasize solid-state techniques, advanced dissimilar metal joining, and AI optimization to enhance welding efficiency and quality. Welding of modern Mg-inclusive high-entropy alloys is under intensive development.

infographic.key_insight: Magnesium alloy joints are difficult to weld reliably, so the review emphasizes process choice and parameter control to reduce cracking and preserve joint integrity.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The paper is relevant to lightweight automotive and advanced structural design because it compares weldability, defect risks, and joint performance across major Mg welding routes.

zh-Hans.title: 镁合金接头的焊接技术：综合综述
zh-Hans.abstract: 镁（Mg）合金对于汽车轻量化设计至关重要，这凸显了尽管其可焊性较差且易产生裂纹等缺陷，仍需采用有效焊接方法的必要性。本文通过使用适当关键词检索可获得的科学数据库中的研究与专利进行综述而撰写。文章回顾了镁合金的性能、应用和焊接方法（熔化焊、摩擦焊、扩散焊、爆炸焊和复合焊），并评估了它们的优点、缺点和注意事项。文中强调了理解焊接接头力学行为和结构完整性的重要性，同时还讨论了工艺变量对焊缝显微组织和性能的影响以及未来研究方向。研究发现，AZ系列镁合金因其可焊性而更受青睐。对于这类合金，主要焊接方法包括GTAW、GMAW、LBW和FSW。发展趋势强调固态技术、先进异种金属连接以及AI优化，以提高焊接效率和质量。现代含镁高熵合金的焊接正处于深入发展之中。

title: Study of the Corrosion Resistance of Cr3C2-NiCr-Based Gradient Detonation Coatings
authors: Merkhat Dautbekov, Bauyrzhan Rakhadilov, Dauir Kakimzhanov, Laila Sulyubayeva
abstract: This study presents a comparative investigation of the structure, adhesion and corrosion properties of homogeneous and gradient Cr3C2-NiCr detonation coatings formed on the surface of 12Kh1MF steel. A Cr3C2-NiCr composite powder with a composition of 75/25 and a particle size of 10–45 µm was used to apply the coatings, using a CCDS2000 detonation spraying system. A homogeneous coating was formed at a constant gas mixture filling ratio of 57 per cent, whilst a gradient coating was obtained by sequentially varying the filling ratio from 57 to 64 to 73 per cent, which ensured the formation of layers with different structural and phase states. An investigation of the microstructure and elemental composition revealed a uniform distribution of components in the homogeneous coating and a regular variation in the Cr and Ni content across the thickness of the gradient coating. X-ray phase analysis identified the presence of the Cr3C2, Cr3Ni2 and CrNi3 phases. Corrosion resistance was assessed using the potentiodynamic polarization method in a 3.5 per cent Na2SO4 solution and through long-term tests in hydrochloric acid mist with the addition of CuCl2·2H2O, lasting up to 1000 h. The polarization curves of the gradient coating were shifted towards the region of lower current densities, indicating a slowing down of both anodic and cathodic electrochemical processes. In the tested specimens, visible corrosion was first observed on the homogeneous coating after 456 h, whereas no visible corrosion damage was observed on the gradient coating after 1000 h. Mass loss amounted to 1.14 per cent for the homogeneous coating and 0.17 per cent for the gradient coating. The enhanced corrosion resistance of the gradient coating is due to its denser layered structure and the barrier effect of the interlayer boundaries, which prevent the propagation of through-cracks and the penetration of the aggressive medium to the ‘coating-substrate’ interface. The results obtained demonstrate the potential of forming a Cr3C2-NiCr gradient structure to enhance the protective and operational characteristics of detonation coatings.

infographic.key_insight: A graded Cr3C2-NiCr detonation coating outperformed a homogeneous coating by creating a denser layered barrier that better resists corrosive attack.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Designing composition gradients in detonation-sprayed coatings can substantially improve service life for steel components exposed to aggressive environments.

Evaluated microstructure, phase composition, polarization behavior, and long-term corrosion in Na2SO4 and HCl mist with CuCl2·2H2O

zh-Hans.title: Cr3C2-NiCr基梯度爆炸喷涂涂层耐腐蚀性研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究对形成于12Kh1MF钢表面的均匀和梯度Cr3C2-NiCr爆炸喷涂涂层的结构、结合强度和耐腐蚀性能进行了比较研究。采用成分为75/25、粒径为10–45 µm的Cr3C2-NiCr复合粉末，并使用CCDS2000爆炸喷涂系统制备涂层。均匀涂层在57%的恒定气体混合物充装比下形成，而梯度涂层则通过将充装比依次从57%调整至64%再到73%获得，从而确保形成具有不同结构和相状态的各层。对显微组织和元素组成的研究表明，均匀涂层中各组分分布均匀，而梯度涂层沿厚度方向Cr和Ni含量呈规律变化。X射线相分析确定存在Cr3C2、Cr3Ni2和CrNi3相。采用3.5% Na2SO4溶液中的动电位极化法以及在加入CuCl2·2H2O的盐酸酸雾中的长期试验（最长1000 h）评估耐腐蚀性。梯度涂层的极化曲线向较低电流密度区域移动，表明阳极和阴极电化学过程均有所减缓。在所测试样品中，均匀涂层在456 h后首次观察到可见腐蚀，而梯度涂层在1000 h后未观察到可见腐蚀损伤。均匀涂层的质量损失为1.14%，梯度涂层为0.17%。梯度涂层耐腐蚀性提高归因于其更致密的层状结构以及层间界面的屏蔽效应，该效应可阻止贯穿裂纹扩展并阻止侵蚀性介质渗透至“涂层-基体”界面。所得结果表明，形成Cr3C2-NiCr梯度结构可提升爆炸喷涂涂层的防护性能和服役性能。

title: The Effect of Ultrasonic Surface Modification of Nanocrystals on the Surface, Microstructure, and Mechanical Properties of a WC-12Co Coating Deposited by Detonation Spraying
authors: Нуртолеу Магазов, Bauyrzhan K. Rakhadilov, Auezhan T. Amanov, Arystanbek Kussainov, Dauir Kakimzhanov, Yermakhan Molbossynov
abstract: This study investigates the effect of a static contact load applied during ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification (UNSM) on WC-12Co coatings deposited by detonation spraying. Surface roughness, surface and cross-sectional microstructure, mechanical properties, and adhesion–cohesion strength were evaluated using contact profilometry, scanning electron microscopy (SEM), instrumental indentation (ISO 14577-1), and progressive-load scratch testing (ASTM C1624) under static contact loads of P = 10, 20, 30, and 40 N at fixed amplitude, frequency, and travel speed. Among the treated samples, the arithmetic mean roughness decreased monotonically with increasing load—from Ra = 1.468 ± 0.098 μm at 10 N to 1.158 ± 0.244 μm at 40 N (−21%); pairwise differences fell within the margin of error (p ≥ 0.26), but the linear trend with load was significant (p = 0.039). Maximum profile height (Rz) did not depend on load. The asymmetry Rsk remained negative at all loads, reaching its most negative value at 30 N. Quantitative analysis of the cross-sections yielded coating thicknesses of 230 ± 12, 246 ± 9, 40 ± 6, and 82 ± 7 μm for samples processed at 10, 20, 30, and 40 N, respectively; this variation in thickness is taken into account when interpreting the scratch tests. The average Vickers hardness and indentation modulus exceeded the values for the sprayed material at any load; the EIT peaked at 20 N; and the coefficient of friction in the range Fn = 0–30 N decreased by 17% between 10 and 40 N. We determined P = 30 N as the optimal static contact load: it provides the smallest residual scratch depth (5.5 ± 1.8 μm) and the highest cohesive critical load (Lc1 = 50.2 N), whereas 40 N further reduces roughness but decreases Lc1 to 38.3 N. This conclusion is preliminary because coating thickness varies across the series, and at the final scratching load the indenter extends beyond the coating boundaries on the thinnest samples. The results identify a provisional useful load range for this specimen series. Establishing whether the deposition route changes the UNSM processing window requires a controlled comparison with coatings deposited by other methods, together with measurements of residual stress and near-surface microstructure.

infographic.engineering_relevance: For detonation-sprayed hard coatings, tuning UNSM load can meaningfully trade roughness reduction against adhesion/cohesion behavior, helping identify a practical processing window.

Surface and cross-sectional changes were measured using profilometry and SEM.

zh-Hans.title: 超声表面改性纳米晶体对爆炸喷涂沉积 WC-12Co 涂层表面、微观组织和力学性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了在超声纳米晶表面改性（UNSM）过程中施加静态接触载荷对爆炸喷涂制备的 WC-12Co 涂层的影响。在固定振幅、频率和行程速度条件下，采用接触式轮廓仪、扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、仪器化压痕（ISO 14577-1）和渐进载荷划痕试验（ASTM C1624），对静态接触载荷 P = 10、20、30 和 40 N 条件下样品的表面粗糙度、表面及截面微观组织、力学性能以及黏附—内聚强度进行了评估。在处理样品中，算术平均粗糙度随载荷增加而单调降低——从 10 N 时的 Ra = 1.468 ± 0.098 μm 降至 40 N 时的 1.158 ± 0.244 μm（降低 21%）；两两差异均落在误差范围内（p ≥ 0.26），但载荷的线性趋势显著（p = 0.039）。最大轮廓高度（Rz）与载荷无关。偏度 Rsk 在所有载荷下均为负值，并在 30 N 时达到最负值。对截面进行定量分析得到，在 10、20、30 和 40 N 处理条件下，涂层厚度分别为 230 ± 12、246 ± 9、40 ± 6 和 82 ± 7 μm；在解释划痕试验结果时需考虑这种厚度差异。平均维氏硬度和压痕模量在任何载荷下均高于喷涂态材料；EIT 在 20 N 时达到峰值；且 Fn = 0–30 N 范围内的摩擦系数在 10 N 与 40 N 之间降低了 17%。我们确定 P = 30 N 为最佳静态接触载荷：其对应最小残余划痕深度（5.5 ± 1.8 μm）和最高内聚临界载荷（Lc1 = 50.2 N），而 40 N 虽可进一步降低粗糙度，但会使 Lc1 降至 38.3 N。该结论为初步结论，因为该系列样品的涂层厚度存在差异，并且在最终划痕载荷下，对于最薄样品，压头会延伸至涂层边界之外。结果为该样品系列确定了一个暂定的有效载荷范围。要确定沉积路线是否会改变 UNSM 的加工窗口，还需要对比其他方法沉积的涂层进行受控比较，并测量残余应力和近表面微观组织。

infographic.key_insight: 超声纳米晶表面改性可改善 WC-12Co 涂层的表面质量和划痕性能，在本研究中 30 N 作为最佳整体静态接触载荷表现最优。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于爆炸喷涂硬质涂层，调节 UNSM 载荷可有效在粗糙度降低与黏附/内聚行为之间进行权衡，有助于确定可行的加工窗口。
method: 对爆炸喷涂制备的 WC-12Co 涂层施加 UNSM 处理，静态接触载荷分别为 10、20、30 和 40 N。
采用轮廓仪和 SEM 测量表面及截面变化。
通过仪器化压痕和渐进载荷划痕试验评估力学响应。
infographic.evidence_signal: Ra 从 10 N 时的 1.468 ± 0.098 μm 降至 40 N 时的 1.158 ± 0.244 μm，而 30 N 对应最小残余划痕深度（5.5 ± 1.8 μm）和最高内聚临界载荷（Lc1 = 50.2 N）。
infographic.watch_item: 该结论为初步结论，因为不同样品之间涂层厚度变化很大，而且在最薄试样上，划痕压头在最终载荷下可能会延伸到涂层边界之外。

title: Microstructure and interface characteristics of ZrC splats prepared by high temperature atmospheric plasma deposition
authors: Ziyi Yi, Ting Xu, Bing Liu, Keke Wu, Hongkang Ou, Yujia Zhang
abstract: The deposition behavior of molten droplets is critical to the cohesion and adhesion of plasma-sprayed ceramic coatings. To clarify the bonding mechanism of ZrC coatings, this study investigates the microstructure and interface characteristics of ZrC splats fabricated by supersonic atmospheric plasma spraying, focusing on spraying distance effects and inter-splat evolution. Results show 100 mm is optimal for intact, disk-shaped splats without splashing. Stacked ZrC splats are mainly zirconia, with t -ZrO 2 on the top surface and m -ZrO 2 concentrated at contact zones between two splats. A dense, vertically oriented columnar grain zone (∼150 nm) forms between adjacent splats, enabling epitaxial bonding. Furthermore, an amorphous Zr-Si-O interlayer at the splat-substrate interface enhances adhesion. The coating has alternating ZrC/ZrO 2 layers, with ZrC grains encapsulated by nanocrystalline ZrO 2 . This work provides fundamental insights into interface design for high-performance high-temperature ceramic coatings.

infographic.key_insight: Supersonic atmospheric plasma spraying at an optimal 100 mm stand-off produces intact ZrC splats and promotes strong inter-splat bonding through zirconia phase evolution, columnar interfacial grains, and an amorphous Zr-Si-O adhesion layer.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study identifies microstructural features that can be tuned to improve cohesion, adhesion, and high-temperature durability in ceramic thermal-spray coatings.
method: Prepared ZrC splats by high-temperature atmospheric plasma spraying at varied spraying distances.
Characterized splat morphology, phase composition, and cross-sectional interface structure.
Compared stacked splat evolution and splat-substrate interfacial features.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports that 100 mm was optimal for disk-shaped, non-splashed splats and documents phase/interface observations including t-ZrO2, m-ZrO2, ~150 nm columnar grains, and an amorphous Zr-Si-O interlayer.
infographic.watch_item: The findings are highly dependent on spraying distance and process conditions, so the interface structure may not transfer directly to other plasma-spray setups or substrates.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure and interface characteristics of ZrC splats prepared by high temperature atmospheric plasma deposition

zh-Hans.title: 高温大气等离子体沉积制备 ZrC 涂层颗粒铺展体的微观结构与界面特征
zh-Hans.abstract: 熔融液滴的沉积行为对等离子喷涂陶瓷涂层的内聚和附着至关重要。为阐明 ZrC 涂层的结合机制，本研究考察了采用超音速大气等离子喷涂制备的 ZrC 颗粒铺展体的微观结构和界面特征，重点分析喷涂距离效应及颗粒铺展体间演化。结果表明，100 mm 为最佳喷涂距离，可获得完整的、盘状且无飞溅的颗粒铺展体。堆叠的 ZrC 颗粒铺展体主要由氧化锆组成，上表面为 t-ZrO2，而 m-ZrO2 集中分布于两个颗粒铺展体的接触区域。相邻颗粒铺展体之间形成致密、垂直取向的柱状晶粒区（约 150 nm），从而实现外延结合。此外，颗粒铺展体-基体界面处的非晶 Zr-Si-O 中间层增强了附着力。该涂层具有交替的 ZrC/ZrO2 层，其中 ZrC 晶粒被纳米晶 ZrO2 包覆。本研究为高性能高温陶瓷涂层的界面设计提供了基础认识。

infographic.key_insight: 在最佳 100 mm 喷涂距离下，超音速大气等离子喷涂可获得完整的 ZrC 颗粒铺展体，并通过氧化锆相演化、柱状界面晶粒以及非晶 Zr-Si-O 附着层促进强颗粒铺展体间结合。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究识别出可调控的微观结构特征，有助于提高陶瓷热喷涂涂层的内聚性、附着力和高温耐久性。
method: 采用高温大气等离子喷涂在不同喷涂距离下制备 ZrC 颗粒铺展体。
表征颗粒铺展体形貌、相组成和截面界面结构。
比较堆叠颗粒铺展体的演化及颗粒铺展体-基体界面特征。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告 100 mm 适用于获得盘状、无飞溅颗粒铺展体，并记录了包括 t-ZrO2、m-ZrO2、约 150 nm 柱状晶粒以及非晶 Zr-Si-O 中间层在内的相与界面观察结果。
infographic.watch_item: 这些结果高度依赖喷涂距离和工艺条件，因此界面结构未必可直接推广到其他等离子喷涂装置或基体。

title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications
authors: Sama Mukhtar, Amit Sata, Gaurang Joshi, Durgesh Srivastava
abstract: Accurately predicting welding performance measures like ultimate strength (UTS), weld bead hardness, and HAZ mechanical hardness is crucial for ensuring the structural integrity and performance of welded components. Multitask learning (MTL) refers to a machine learning approach in which one model is designed to handle several interconnected tasks at the same time. Instead of training separate models for each task, MTL shares representations among tasks, allowing them to leverage common patterns while maintaining task-specific distinctions. In this study, we compared two advanced machine learning techniques, namely multitask neural network (MTNN) and stacking ensemble learning, for predicting these parameters based on a shared dataset. A multitask neural network (MTNN) is a specific type of multitask learning (MTL) model that uses a deep neural network architecture to handle multiple related tasks simultaneously. In MTNN, different tasks share some hidden layers while having task-specific output layers. This shared representation allows the model to learn common patterns across tasks while maintaining task-specific outputs. Both methods are evaluated using RMSE and R<sup>2</sup> to determine their predictive accuracy and overall effectiveness. It showed robust prediction strength, as its RMSE outcomes are 0.1288 for UTS, 0.0886 for weld hardness, and 0.1125 for HAZ hardness, whereas R<sup>2</sup> values are 0.6724, 0.9215, and 0.8407, respectively. This underlines that it can generalize well in interrelated tasks. Stacking ensemble learning outperformed MTL in the accuracy of individual tasks: the RMSE for UTS is 0.0263 and R<sup>2</sup> is 0.9863; for weld hardness, it is 0.0467 and 0.9782; and for HAZ hardness, it is 0.1109 and 0.8453. Such results indicate the good ability of ensemble methods to produce highly accurate, task-specific predictions. This comparison reveals the trade-offs between the two approaches. MTL is good in scenarios where the tasks are related and the data are sparse, giving efficient training and good generalization; stacking ensembles work better in the case of accurate, independent predictions. In both cases, they show remarkable potential for improving the predictive power of welding applications, making them suitable precursors to further investigation into hybrid models that bring the best features of both approaches together.

infographic.key_insight: Stacking ensemble learning produced more accurate task-specific predictions than a multitask neural network for welding quality metrics, while MTNN still offered strong shared-learning performance across related outputs.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For welding process optimization, the study shows that model choice should match the goal: ensemble methods for highest per-target accuracy, and multitask learning for efficient learning when outputs are coupled and data are limited.
method: Compared a multitask neural network (shared hidden layers with task-specific outputs) against stacking ensemble learning.
Predicted three welding properties: UTS, weld bead hardness, and HAZ hardness.
Evaluated both models using RMSE and R² on the same dataset.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports MTNN RMSE/R² of 0.1288/0.6724 for UTS, 0.0886/0.9215 for weld hardness, and 0.1125/0.8407 for HAZ hardness, while stacking improved to 0.0263/0.9863, 0.0467/0.9782, and 0.1109/0.8453 respectively.
infographic.watch_item: The reported comparison is based on one shared dataset, so generalization to other welding materials, joint types, or process conditions should be validated before deployment.
infographic.paper_title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications

zh-Hans.title: 用于焊接应用中 UTS、焊缝硬度和 HAZ 硬度预测的多任务神经网络与堆叠集成学习比较分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 准确预测焊接性能指标，如极限强度（UTS）、焊缝硬度和 HAZ 机械硬度，对于确保焊接构件的结构完整性和服役性能至关重要。多任务学习（MTL）是一种机器学习方法，其中一个模型被设计用于同时处理多个相互关联的任务。与为每个任务分别训练独立模型不同，MTL 在任务之间共享表征，使其能够利用共同模式，同时保持任务特定差异。在本研究中，我们基于共享数据集，对两种先进的机器学习技术，即多任务神经网络（MTNN）和堆叠集成学习，进行了比较，用于预测这些参数。多任务神经网络（MTNN）是一种特定类型的多任务学习（MTL）模型，它采用深度神经网络架构同时处理多个相关任务。在 MTNN 中，不同任务共享部分隐藏层，同时具有任务特定的输出层。这种共享表征使模型能够学习跨任务的共同模式，同时保持任务特定输出。两种方法均使用 RMSE 和 R<sup>2</sup> 进行评估，以确定其预测精度和整体有效性。结果表明，其具有较强的预测能力，RMSE 分别为 UTS 的 0.1288、焊缝硬度的 0.0886 和 HAZ 硬度的 0.1125，而 R<sup>2</sup> 值分别为 0.6724、0.9215 和 0.8407。这表明其能够在相互关联的任务中实现良好的泛化。堆叠集成学习在单个任务的精度上优于 MTL：UTS 的 RMSE 为 0.0263、R<sup>2</sup> 为 0.9863；焊缝硬度为 0.0467 和 0.9782；HAZ 硬度为 0.1109 和 0.8453。这些结果表明，集成方法在生成高度准确的任务特定预测方面具有良好能力。该比较揭示了两种方法之间的权衡。MTL 适用于任务相关且数据稀疏的场景，能够实现高效训练和良好泛化；堆叠集成在需要高精度、独立预测的情况下表现更好。两种方法都显示出提升焊接应用预测能力的显著潜力，因此适合作为进一步研究融合两种方法最佳特征的混合模型的前期工作。

infographic.key_insight: 堆叠集成学习在焊接质量指标的任务特定预测上比多任务神经网络更准确，而 MTNN 仍在相关输出之间表现出较强的共享学习能力。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于焊接工艺优化，该研究表明模型选择应与目标相匹配：若追求单个目标的最高精度，应采用集成方法；若输出之间存在耦合且数据有限，则多任务学习更适合实现高效学习。
method: 将多任务神经网络（共享隐藏层并具有任务特定输出）与堆叠集成学习进行比较。
预测三种焊接性能：UTS、焊缝硬度和 HAZ 硬度。
在同一数据集上使用 RMSE 和 R² 评估两种模型。
infographic.watch_item: 所报告的比较基于一个共享数据集，因此在部署之前，应验证其在其他焊接材料、接头类型或工艺条件下的泛化能力。
